definitions.title: Taylor Series and Maclaurin Series
definitions.statement: The Taylor series generated by an infinitely differentiable function f at x = a matches all derivatives of f at x = a. A Taylor series centered at a = 0 is called a Maclaurin series.
conditions: f is infinitely differentiable (C^infinity) at a
definitions.explanation: Extends tangent line approximations to polynomial approximations of arbitrary degree.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Coefficients are determined uniquely by c_n = f^(n)(a) / n!.

definitions.title: Standard Maclaurin Series Expansions
definitions.statement: Canonical series expansions valid for all real x with infinite radius of convergence R = oo.
definitions.explanation: Foundation for calculus numerical evaluations and Euler's formula e^(ix) = cos(x) + i sin(x).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Master expansions of exp, sin, and cos.
